purpose: Complete the primitive D4 decision model by integrating the action-dependent second post-flux charge measurement and separating information gain, first-stage myopia, and second-stage algorithmic loss.
epistemic_role: Bounded exact sequential-decision audit on the paper L=2 nonwinding channel; not an LER, threshold, scalable decoder, noisy-measurement, or fault-tolerance result.

source_basis.primary: Jing et al. (2025), Appendix A section 4 and Appendix C section 2: after a homologically trivial physical/correction union, a second simultaneous e-charge measurement obeys one even constraint per colour per connected union component, followed by unit-weight charge MWPM.
source_basis.project_model: The validated R2 pipeline samples the second record uniformly on this affine parity support and scores charge recovery by XOR-residual homology.
source_basis.important_correction: The simulator's -1 value and inferred relation graph are internal generative metadata. The exact decoder-visible second record is a full binary charge vector with deterministic zero outside active union support; neither the active mask nor the hidden physical/correction relation partition is exposed.

scientific_question.primary: How far is the published two-stage D4 policy from the exact policy when the first correction changes the distribution of the later charge record?
scientific_question.mechanism: The first correction is both a recovery action and an intervention: together with the hidden physical error it determines whether failure is immediate and, if not, which affine second-measurement channel is realized.
possible_outcomes: The first-stage action that minimizes immediate union loss is also sequentially optimal, so anticipating the second measurement has zero value on the primitive channel.
A future-aware first action differs from the myopic union-loss action and lowers final risk, demonstrating an active information-gathering or continuation-value effect.
The public first action is near optimal but unit-weight second-stage MWPM causes most of the full-policy gap.
The public first action causes most of the full-policy gap even after an exact second-stage continuation.
The exact O2 policy improves on exact O0, preserving the first-charge information advantage after the adaptive second round.
Any expected risk ordering fails, localizing an observation leak, likelihood error, incomplete action quotient, or implementation defect.

sequential_model.lattice: periodic_honeycomb(2), 12 red edges, with two four-vertex triangular charge lattices
sequential_model.physical_ensemble: The source-frozen R4.4 nonwinding physical-error ensemble at p={0.1,0.3,0.5,0.6}; terminal physical-winding prior mass is retained and reported separately.

initial_observations.o2: red flux syndrome plus the physically allowed first fusion-charge record

sequential_model.first_action: For each initial flux syndrome, choose one of all 32 syndrome-faithful red-X corrections. Public O0 uses unit-weight MWPM; public O2 uses the published 1-n_e K herald-weight MWPM.
sequential_model.immediate_branch: For hidden physical mask E and first action A, any winding component in E union A is terminal logical loss one and emits no second record.
sequential_model.second_observation: For a homologically trivial union, infer its same-colour parity components only inside the generative likelihood. The decoder-visible Y is a binary value on every star, with zero outside the active union support.
sequential_model.second_observation_likelihood: Let N(E,A) be the number of active stars and C(E,A) the number of independent even-parity components across both colours. Then P(Y=y|E,A)=2^(C-N) when y is zero outside the active set and has even parity on every component, and zero otherwise.
sequential_model.second_action: For each colour, quotient all charge corrections with boundary Y by the four torus homology sectors. The joint exact action space therefore has 4x4=16 blue/green sector pairs; a representative within a sector cannot change XOR-residual homology.
sequential_model.terminal_loss: One iff the first union winds or, after a nonwinding first branch, either colour's effective-Z/correction XOR residual has nontrivial winding.
sequential_model.observable_history: An exact second-stage decision may condition on (O,A,Y), where O is O0 or O2 and A is the known chosen first action. It may not condition on E, inferred relation components, active-set metadata, simulator sentinels, or truth-derived effective strings.

policy_matrix.public_fixed: Published first-stage action for O0 or O2 followed by unit-weight charge MWPM using only the measured charge syndrome.
policy_matrix.fixed_first_exact_continuation: Hold the corresponding public first action fixed, then choose the exact 16-class second action from the posterior given observable history.
policy_matrix.myopic_first_exact_continuation: Choose an R4.4 immediate union-loss-minimizing first action with a deterministic mask tie break, then use the exact second continuation.
policy_matrix.future_aware_exact: Choose the first action minimizing immediate failure plus posterior-optimal continuation loss, then choose the exact second action after Y.

estimands: exact sequential risk under O0 and O2, both nonwinding-conditioned and with terminal physical-winding mass restored
second-stage MWPM excess at the fixed public first action
public first-action excess after exact continuation
myopia cost of the immediate union-loss first action
observation-probability mass on which future-aware and myopic/public first actions differ

required: all source hashes match the registration freeze
the exact second-channel support and 2^(C-N) likelihood normalize independently for every nonterminal (E,A)
full-binary Y is obtained by replacing internal inactive -1 sentinels with zero, and neither the active mask nor relation partition enters a decoder key
the exact enumerator reproduces the seeded public sampler support on bounded fixtures without using samples as likelihood evidence
all 32 first actions are unique and syndrome faithful and both public actions belong to the set
four charge homology classes per colour are complete and loss-equivalent to exhaustive affine charge chains for every supported syndrome
public second-stage corrections belong to the registered charge-sector action quotient
posterior mass is conserved from O0/O2 through immediate-failure and all Y branches
O2 future-aware exact risk does not exceed O0 future-aware exact risk
future-aware exact risk does not exceed myopic, fixed-first/exact-continuation, or public risk at the same observation layer
fixed-first exact continuation does not exceed the corresponding public full-policy risk
no truth metadata, new stochastic sample, larger lattice, noisy measurement, LER, or threshold claim is introduced

sensitivity.tie_policy: Use minimum correction mask for exact first-action and charge-sector ties; report tie counts and verify Bayes risk is invariant to the representative.
sensitivity.observable_ablation: Run a leak diagnostic that intentionally adds the hidden active/relation metadata only as a labeled oracle upper bound; it must not be used as the primary exact policy.
sensitivity.continuation_ablation: Report myopic, fixed-public-first, and future-aware policies rather than attributing the total gap to one stage.

compute_budget.preflight_rule: Before the full four-prior run, verify exact structural counts and time a deterministic source-frozen subset. Stop and register an algebraically equivalent aggregation if the transition, wall-time, or memory guard would be exceeded.
compute_budget.stop_rule: Stop after one complete primitive O0/O2 sequential policy matrix, exact validations, machine-readable audit, and report update; do not launch R5 or any larger/noisy simulation.

preflight_outcome.passing_gates: The exact second-record likelihood normalizes, observation keys exclude hidden metadata, 2,320,936 streamed transitions fit the registered count guard, and projected wall time and memory fit their guards.
preflight_outcome.failed_gate: The primitive periodic_honeycomb(2) charge sublattice is a multigraph: for each colour its 12 physical triangular edges collapse to six endpoint pairs, every pair has two branches with distinct periodic displacement, and the production endpoint-only ChargeLattice rejects this degeneracy.
preflight_outcome.consequence: The registered sixteen-class charge-action quotient and public second-stage MWPM are undefined on the R4 primitive topology. No sequential Bayes risk may be computed from this contract until branch-labelled charge edges and post-flux relations are derived and independently validated.
preflight_outcome.next_prerequisite: Register and validate a topology-preserving branch-labelled primitive charge multigraph, including relation-to-edge provenance and homology fixtures, before re-registering the R4.5 policy computation.
